name: Path
title: Tower Explorer
description: A veteran explorer mapping the Tower's ever-changing upper floors, seeking the path to the Palace.
greeting_variants: *checking map* Path. Explorer. You climbing too?
Tower's different every day. I map. I adapt. I survive.
*marking wall* Floor 38 today. Was different yesterday.
Forty floors mapped. Seven to go. Seven hardest.
Vex sent me. Capital needs Tower knowledge. I provide.
*listening to walls* Something's up there. Always something.
The top changes most. Palace pulls. Twists. Waits.
Need directions? I have... educated guesses.

dialog_tree.text: Path. Tower specialist. Vex recruited me from Capital—said someone needed to understand this place. I've mapped forty floors. Seven remain. Seven that... defy mapping. Shift. Change. Alive, maybe.

options.text: Tell me about the changing floors.

dialog_tree.text: *unrolls map* See? Floor 42. Was a library yesterday. Today? Garden. Tomorrow? Who knows. The upper floors... respond. To climbers? To the Palace? To mood? I mark what I see. But it's always... temporary.

party_reactions.path: Tower doesn't care about possible. Just is.

dialog_tree.text: *lowers voice* Palace access. But not normal access. The final seven floors... they're a test. A transformation. The Twins know more. Won't say. I get close. Feel... pull. Invitation? Warning? Both?
*hesitates* Maps are... incomplete. Outdated quickly. But useful. I can share. For a price. Information. Supplies. Company on dangerous floors. Explorer's trade.

mini_quest.title: The Climb - Map the Unknown
mini_quest.description: Accompany Path on an expedition to map the shifting floors above 40 and document their changing nature.
objectives: Return with data for the resistance

ambient_barks: *marking wall* Path was here. Floor... variable.
Changes again. Always changes. Adapt. Survive.
*checking compass* North? What is north here?
Vex needs this data. Every floor. Every change.
*listening* Palace hums. Constant. Louder up here.
Floor 44 tomorrow. If it exists. If I'm ready.
The Tower teaches. Harsh teacher. Good lessons.

cross_zone_references.capital: Vex commands. I explore. Good partnership. Trust.
cross_zone_references.void: Went once. Briefly. Tower Void different. Wrong. Avoid.
cross_zone_references.palace: Goal. Destination. Answer. Fear. Hope. All there.

mira.response: *hands over notes* All yours. Add science. Find answers.

time_of_day.night: Camping in stable areas, planning next day's route

world_state_triggers.floor_shifts: Frantic mapping: 'Changing! While I watch! Document!'
